title: 50 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Mindfulness)
description:
Learn 50 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Mindfulness · Kujitambua
1:23  Daily Routine · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
2:38  Joy · Shangwe
4:02  Motivation · Motisha
5:21  Doctor & Pharmacy · Daktari na Dawa
6:53  Making Plans · Kupanga Mipango
8:14  Gratitude · Shukrani
9:29  Forgiveness · Msamaha

PHRASE LIST

MINDFULNESS · Kujitambua
• Breathe in, feel your feet. - Pumua ndani, jisikie miguu yako.  [pUMua NDANI, jiSIkie miGUu yaKO.]
• Notice what your body is saying. - Tambua kile mwili wako unachosema.  [TAMbua KILE mWILI waKO uNAchOsemA.]
• Pause, then check your thoughts kindly. - Acha kidogo, kisha angalia mawazo yako kwa upole.  [aCHA kiDOgo, kisha aNGALIA maWAZO yaKO kwa uPOle.]
• Say hello to your feelings right now. - Sema salama na hisia zako sasa hivi.  [SEma saLAMA na HI si a zaKO saSA hi vi.]
• Let your shoulders drop gently. - Acha mabega yashuke polepole.  [aCHA maBEga yaSHUke poLEpoLE.]
• Where do you feel tension today? - Mkazo upo wapi leo?  [mKAZo uPO waPI leO.]

DAILY ROUTINE · Ratiba ya Kila Siku
• I wake up before sunrise - Ninaamka kabla ya jua kuchomoa  [Ninaamka KA-bla ya Jua KU-cho-moa]
• I drink water after brushing - Nanywa maji baada ya kupiga mswaki  [Na-nywa MA-ji BA-a-da ya ku-pi-ga mswa-ki]
• I wash my face right away - Nawa uso mara moja  [Na-wa USO ma-ra JO-a]
• I make coffee and sit down - Naitengeneza kahawa, halafu nakaa chini  [Na-i-ten-ge-nza KA-ha-wa, ha-lafu na-kaa CHI-nhi]
• I eat breakfast with the news - Nala kifungua kinywa nikisikiliza habari  [Na-la ki-FU-ngu-a KIN-ywa ni-ki-si-ki-li-za HA-bi-ri]
• I pack my bag for work - Naandaa begi langu kwa kazi  [Na-an-da-a BE-gi lan-gu kwa KA-zi]

JOY · Shangwe
• I’m celebrating, I need music tonight. - Nina shangwe, ninahitaji muziki usiku wa leo.  [Nina SHANGWE, ninahitaji mu-ZIKI USI-KU wa LEO.]
• Come over, we’re roasting peanuts together. - Njoo, tunasherehekea kwa kuchoma karanga.  [NJOO, tu-na-SHE-RE-HE-kea kwa KU-cho-ma KA-RAN-ga.]
• Happy vibes, even the street feels alive. - Furaha ipo, hata barabarani kuna uhai.  [FU-ra-ha I-po, ha-ta ba-ra-BA-ra-ni ku-na u-HAI.]
• Your laugh just turned my day around. - Kicheko chako kimenigeuza siku yangu.  [KI-che-ko CHA-ko ki-me-NI-geu-za SI-ku yan-gu.]
• Let’s toast, this is a big win. - Tufanye toast, hii ni ushindi mkubwa.  [TU-fanye TOAST, HII ni u-SHIN-di MKU-bwa.]
• I’ll bring cake, you bring smiles. - Nitawaletea keki, mlete furaha tu.  [Ni-ta-wa-le-TE-a KE-ki, mLE-te FU-ra-ha TU.]

MOTIVATION · Motisha
• I can do this, step by step. - Naweza kufanya hivyo, hatua kwa hatua.  [NAWEZA kufanya HIVYO, HATUA kwa HATUA]
• Small wins count, today matters. - Ushindi mdogo unahesabika, leo ni muhimu.  [USHINDI mdogo unAHESABIKA, LEO ni MUHIMU]
• Breathe, then begin again. - Pumua, kisha uanze tena.  [PUMUA, KISHA uANZE TENA]
• Even imperfect attempts move me. - Kufanya kwa makosa pia kunanisogeza mbele.  [KUFAna kwa MAKOsa pia kunANISOGEZA MBELE]
• I will show up, no excuses. - Nitaonekana, bila visingizio.  [NITAAonekana, BILA VISINGIZIO]
• Tell yourself, I’m getting stronger. - Jiseme, naimarika kila siku.  [JISEME, NAIMARIKA KILA SIKU]

DOCTOR & PHARMACY · Daktari na Dawa
• I need a prescription refill today. - Naomba kupata dawa tena kwa agizo leo.  [NaOMba kupata DAwa teNA kwa aGIZo leO.]
• How do I take this medicine? - Ninawezaje kunywa dawa hii, kwa mpangilio gani?  [NiNawezaJE kuNYwa DAwa hiI, kwa mPAngiLIO gaNI?]
• Will this interact with my meds? - Je, dawa hii inaweza kuingiliana na dawa zangu nyingine?  [Je, DAwa hii eiNAna kuINGiLIAna na DAwa zaNgu ingINE?]
• Do I need antibiotics for this? - Nahitaji viua vijasumu, au ni dawa nyingine tu?  [NiAHchi viU a viJASuMu, au ni DAwa ingINE tu?]
• Can you check my symptoms now? - Tafadhali niangalie dalili zangu sasa hivi.  [TaFAdhali niANgaLie DAliLi zaNgu saSA hiVi.]
• I have a mild fever. - Nina homa ya wastani tu.  [NiNA hoMA ya WAStaNi tu.]
• My throat is very sore. - Koo langu linauma sana.  [KOO lanGu liNAuMA saNA.]

MAKING PLANS · Kupanga Mipango
• Can we pick a time today? - Tunaweza kuchagua muda leo?  [TUNAWEZA CHAGUA Muda LEO?]
• Let’s plan this for next week. - Tuipange wiki ijayo.  [TUIPANga WIKI IJAYO.]
• I need to check my schedule. - Nahitaji kuangalia ratiba yangu.  [NANIHITAJI KU-ANGALIA RA-TI-BA YANGU.]
• What time suits you best? - Ni saa gani inakufaa zaidi?  [NI SAA GANI INAKU-Faa ZAIDI?]
